The structure of Li2Mn2Cu12O20 (reduced formula LiMn(Cu3O5)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 36 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Cu environments coordinated by six O neighbors (16 atoms in the cell), while Li and Mn each show eight O neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. Cu octahedra exhibit corner- and edge-sharing, and Cu octahedra also share corners and faces with 12-vertex O-centered polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites.
